versions.changelog: Sync display name with SkillHub: 技能盘点+健康体检 · Skill Inventory & Health Check; bump 1.5.3

TRACE report remediation (1.3.3 -> 1.4.0): (1) new FAQ section with 9 Q&As in SKILL.md plus a 5-question quick reference in README, including a 6-row error-code table (E-LOG/E-ROOT/E-PLATFORM/E-NOCLOSE/E-CONF/E-READ); (2) the built-in frontmatter parser now implements real YAML block-scalar semantics (blank lines inside folded blocks are no longer dropped) and a new --selftest passes 8/8 with and without PyYAML; (3) 15 internal progress markers rewritten as plain design rationale; usage-log warnings now carry an error code, the consequence and the next step; (4) config writes are atomic (temp file + os.replace) and leave the original intact on failure; reads retry twice on file-busy errors; (5) the Chinese and English editions are content-parity (measured char counts, matching section and FAQ counts). No runtime third-party deps, no network, no subprocesses.

Scanner-driven hardening v1.3.1-v1.3.3: (1) rephrased the SKILL.en.md bullet that tripped the secret regex; (2) report-language wording no longer uses always/始终 — 'report language pinned to X, change any time'; (3) maintainer docs (publishing checklist / trigger archive) no longer ship in the package, kept in the repo; (4) declared the third on-disk artifact — the timestamped settings.json.bak.<ts> safety copy created before the close write (only under --apply --yes, path printed, never read back), verified end-to-end in an isolated sandbox; (5) persistence cut for the language preference file (display preference, not a persistence mechanism) written into all five declaration sites; (6) auto is now stated as the fallback for users without an expressed preference, not a lock-in. README appeal section rebuilt as a rule-by-rule fact table. No runtime third-party deps, no network, no subprocesses.

Language setting: --set-lang auto|zh|en (saved preference, effective immediately) + --show-lang (current setting and option descriptions); --lang stays a one-off override; auto follows the conversation language (fallback env -> system locale -> Chinese). All docs now ship in Chinese+English pairs. Permission declarations updated: two disclosed consent-gated write paths (skillOverrides close + language preference file); still no network, no subprocesses, no persistence mechanisms.

v1.2.0: explicit permission & persistence declarations (write scope = skillOverrides key only, consent-gated, reversible; no cron/startup/daemon/self-modification); user language choice via --lang en|zh or SKILL_INV_LANG env; clawhub CLI pinned in maintainer docs (Rp1 fix); bilingual publishing checklist.

v1.1.0: bilingual docs (ZH+EN), --lang en|zh report switch, JSON always English-keyed; behaviour contract rewritten as 'read-only by default, single consent-gated write path (--apply --yes, auto-backup, dry-run without --yes)'; explicit permission declaration (no network, no subprocesses); concrete trigger phrases + exclusions; config.yaml excluded from package.

v1.0.0: office-agent-generic skill inventory & health check - multi-root scan, usage telemetry adapters, reverse-dependency reference locking, impact preview (--impact), 8 anti-accidental-close guardrails. Pure local static analysis, zero network.
